name: Chai Point
short_description: India's largest organized tea café chain serving freshly brewed teas, snacks, and beverages across retail and office locations.
description: Chai Point is India's largest organized tea café chain, offering a wide range of freshly brewed teas, snacks, and beverages. Founded with the mission to serve consistent, high-quality tea across offices, retail outlets, and vending machines, Chai Point combines technology with a love for chai. The brand operates through a strong franchise and vending model, making it one of the most recognizable tea brands in the country.

name: Cha Republic
short_description: Pioneering Indian bubble-tea brand with authentic Far Eastern flavors
description: Cha Republic is a pioneering Indian bubble-tea brand that introduced authentic Far Eastern bubble tea to South India, building a strong identity around innovation, global flavors, and its signature purple aesthetic. With a diverse menu of 125+ premium beverages, it operates 15 outlets across Chennai in high-footfall locations.
leader_name: Ms. Vanitha Ramasamy and Ms. Kavitha Devaraju

name: Chai Topup
short_description: India's first low-investment tea franchise with affordable, high-quality chai
description: Chai Topup is a fast-growing Indian tea and beverage chain with 37-40 outlets across Maharashtra, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh, known for affordable, high-quality chai and a diversified menu. Positioned as India's first low-investment tea franchise, it offers entry starting at 1 lakh with strong training, operational support, and quick payback potential.
business_type: Private franchise brand offering single-unit & master franchise opportunities

name: Cafe Durga
short_description: Maharashtra-based cafe chain known for iconic cold coffee and affordable everyday food
description: Cafe Durga is a Maharashtra-based cafe chain founded in 2003 in Pune, widely known for its iconic cold coffee and affordable, everyday food offerings. With 30+ outlets across Pune and other Maharashtra cities, it serves a strong student and working-professional base through a casual, value-driven format and a growing franchise model.

name: Espresso Bar Co.
short_description: Premium bar-themed cafe franchise offering coffee, mocktails, and light food
description: Espresso Bar Co. is a premium bar-themed cafe franchise offering coffee, mocktails, and light food, operated under Pick Me Foods and Beverages Pvt. Ltd. Positioned as a scalable franchise, it requires an estimated ?20-30 lakh investment and provides end-to-end support for compact outlets, with ambitions for pan-India expansion despite limited current presence.
parent_company: Pick Me Foods and Beverages Private Limited

name: Indian Silk House Agencies
short_description: Prominent Indian ethnic wear retail chain specializing in silk sarees and traditional clothing
description: Indian Silk House Agencies is a prominent Indian ethnic wear retail chain specializing in silk sarees, traditional clothing, and fashion accessories. Founded in 1971, when Sri Dilip Kumar Samsukha and Sri Tarun Kumar Samsukha established a new showroom on Rashbehari Avenue in Kolkata, adding "Agencies" to the name (the original Indian Silk House was founded by Sri Sumati Chand Samsukha in North Kolkata). The brand became prominent when Mrs. Pratibha Dudhoria took over the Rashbehari showroom in 1998 and significantly expanded operations. The brand has rapidly expanded to over 60+ stores across 10+ states in India. Headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, Indian Silk House Agencies has become East India's largest saree brand, known for its authentic heritage silk sarees and quality craftsmanship.

name: Flyrobe
short_description: India's first and largest online fashion rental platform offering designer clothing rental for men and women
description: Flyrobe is India's first and largest online fashion rental platform, founded in 2015 by Shreya Mishra, Tushar Saxena, and Pranay Surana. Acquired by AARK World Pvt. Ltd. in 2019, it serves 30+ cities online with 20+ physical stores. Flyrobe focuses on sustainable fashion, offering designer ethnic wear, western wear, wedding attire, and accessories at a fraction of retail prices.
leader_name: Aanchal Saini, Shreya Mishra, Pranay Ashok Surana, Tushar Saxena

name: Cotton Culture
short_description: Prominent Indian women's ethnic wear brand offering franchise opportunities
description: Cotton Culture is a leading Indian women's ethnic wear fashion brand, established in 2010, with 43-45 company-owned stores and 22 franchise outlets. The brand offers kurtis, suits, tops, palazzos, and coordinated sets, blending traditional textiles with contemporary fashion. Franchise opportunities are available pan-India with full support in marketing, training, and operations.

name: Giordano International Limited
short_description: International casual wear brand offering franchise opportunities in India
description: Giordano International Limited is a leading international retailer of men's, women's, and children's apparel founded in Hong Kong in 1981. The brand operates 1,800 stores across 30+ countries and offers franchise opportunities in India through Brandztorm India, with 58 points-of-sale across 23 cities and 13 states. Giordano provides casual wear, accessories, and comprehensive operational support to franchisees.

name: Liker Store
short_description: Women's ethnic and western wear retail franchise in India
description: Liker Store is a women's clothing retail brand specializing in ethnic and western fashion wear, operating under N&P Singh Private Limited. Founded in 2013, the brand offers premium-quality apparel including kurtis, tops, leggings, lehengas, and western dresses. Franchise opportunities are available across India with focus on tier-1 and tier-2 cities.

name: Store Senor
short_description: Premium men's ethnic and wedding wear franchise in India
description: Store Senor is a premium men's ethnic and wedding wear brand specializing in Sherwanis, Indo Westerns, Tuxedos, Band Galas, Kurta Pyjamas, and Nehru Jackets. Established in 2023 under Enzed Global Private Limited, the brand operates stores in Gurugram and Delhi, and launched its franchise model in 2024 targeting premium to luxury customers. Franchise opportunities are available across India with comprehensive support.

name: Peachmode
short_description: Popular women's ethnic wear franchise in India
description: Peachmode is a prominent Indian women's ethnic wear brand specializing in modern Indian fashion blending traditional aesthetics with contemporary trends. Founded in 2014, the brand has 42+ offline stores and a strong digital presence. Franchise opportunities available across India, offering training, operational support, and marketing assistance. Investment ranges from ?10-50 Lakhs depending on model and location.

name: Tim Paris
short_description: Contemporary Indian men's casual wear brand
description: Tim Paris is a contemporary Indian men's casual wear brand specializing in high-quality everyday essentials in the value format segment. Launched in April 2022 by Primafashion Global Private Limited (PGPL), the brand has rapidly expanded to become one of India's fastest-growing men's fashion chains. Founded by Capt. Rahul Rajyaguru (Co-Founder & Director) and Sandeep Chaudhary (Co-Founder & Director), Tim Paris blends essential wear with luxury. The brand operates on a vertically integrated model covering design, manufacturing, and retail, and has aggressive expansion plans across India.
leader_name: Capt. Rahul Rajyaguru, Sandeep Chaudhary, Sukhraj Singh

name: Liverpool
short_description: Award-winning Indian menswear brand
description: Liverpool is an award-winning men's fashion brand launched in 2017 as an initiative of Sunrise Bizcom Pvt. Ltd. The brand has grown to become one of India's most trusted menswear brands with outlets across 40 cities. Liverpool specializes in casual menswear including shirts, denims, trousers, chinos, and accessories, promoting "Value for Money" as its key motto.

name: Banana Club
short_description: Premium D2C menswear brand from India
description: Banana Club is a premium D2C men's fashion brand founded in 2011. It offers high-street western wear inspired by global runway trends. The brand operates both offline stores and online platforms, ensuring a "Made In Bharat" positioning. Banana Club raised ?12.25 crore on the Indian TV show "Pitch To Get Rich" in October 2025 at a valuation of ?245 crore and operates 16+ stores across India.
parent_company: Banana Club Clothing Private Limited (Manufacturing) / Banana Club In Vogue Private Limited (Retail)

name: Sports Station
short_description: Multi-brand sportswear retailer across India
description: Sports Station is a leading multi-brand sportswear retailer under the SSIPL Group, offering products from global giants like Nike, Adidas, and Puma. The brand targets high-footfall locations across India with a franchise model requiring ?50 lakh - 1 crore investment, featuring zero royalty fees and comprehensive operational support. Sports Station has over 50 outlets across India.
parent_company: SSIPL Group (Super Sports India Private Limited)

name: Dazzle SportsWear
short_description: Affordable Make in India sportswear and casual wear
description: Dazzle SportsWear is a "Make in India" apparel brand founded by a former international volleyball player. The brand specializes in affordable, high-quality sportswear and leisurewear. It has a low entry cost of ?20-30 Lakh, offers a high ROI of 45%, and focuses on Tier 2/3 city expansion along with eco-friendly product lines. Currently, the brand has over 20 outlets across India.

name: Adidas
short_description: Global premium sportswear and footwear brand
description: A global sportswear giant offering a premium retail franchise opportunity with a strong presence in metros and Tier-1 cities. The model requires an investment of ?30-50 Lakhs, backed by powerful global marketing and a quick payback period of around 1 year.

name: Maverick Turf
short_description: Specialized B2B sports infrastructure and turf services
description: An expert sports infrastructure franchise specializing in sports turf, stadium seating, and portable pitches. The model requires a low initial investment of ?2-5 Lakhs and offers fast ROI of 50% with a short payback period of just 3 months. Focused on selective expansion in metros and Tier-2 cities.

name: Cricket Academy of Pathans
short_description: Professional cricket coaching academy
description: Cricket Academy of Pathans (CAP) is a franchise-based cricket training academy founded by Irfan Pathan and Yusuf Pathan. It offers professional cricket coaching, player development programs, and technology-based performance analysis through PitchVision. The academy follows a private entrepreneur franchise model, rapidly expanding across India and international markets.

name: O2 Gym Fitness
short_description: Premium fitness and wellness franchise
description: O2 Gym Fitness is a premium fitness and wellness franchise in India providing gym, wellness, cardio, and strength training services. It operates on a franchise model with a 0% royalty system to maximize franchisee profitability and has expansion opportunities across Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities.

name: Burn Gym and Spa
short_description: Premium fitness and wellness franchise
description: Burn Gym and Spa offers premium gym, spa, personal training, and boot camp services. Operating on a private entrepreneur franchise model, it focuses on Tier-1 cities in North India, providing full operational and marketing support to franchisees.

name: Nitsa Holidays
short_description: Customized international travel and holiday planning
description: Nitsa Holidays specializes in customized international tour packages and personalized vacations for Indian travellers. It operates on a franchise model in online travel services, offering full operational and marketing support to franchisees.
business_type: Franchise model in online travel services, service-based travel agency

name: EaseMyTrip
short_description: India's leading online travel company offering flight bookings, hotels, holidays, and travel services through franchises
description: EaseMyTrip operates a franchise retail travel outlet model, providing comprehensive online and offline travel booking services, including flights, hotels, holidays, trains, cabs, cruises, and visas. The company supports franchisees with training, marketing, store setup, and ongoing operational assistance.

name: MakeMyTrip India Pvt Ltd.
short_description: India's leading online travel company offering flights, hotels, holiday packages, trains, car rentals via franchises
description: MakeMyTrip operates a franchise retail travel outlet model providing comprehensive online and offline travel booking services including flights, hotels, holiday packages, trains, car rentals, and insurance. Franchisees receive training, marketing, operational, and technical support.

name: Cloud9Trip
short_description: Travel brand under Sohan Tours and Travels; started as air ticketing in 2009, expanded to international holidays and tour packages.
description: Cloud9Trip (trademark/brand of Sohan Tours and Travels). Offers comprehensive travel services including flights, hotels, holiday packages, visa, and insurance. Franchisees get training, marketing, operational, and technical support.

name: Thomas Cook India Pvt. Ltd.
short_description: Leading travel and financial services company offering holiday packages, forex, and insurance solutions.
description: Thomas Cook India provides travel services including international and domestic holidays, flight bookings, hotels, forex, insurance, and corporate travel. Franchisees get operational support, marketing guidance, and technical assistance.

name: Club Travalet
short_description: Timeshare vacation franchise offering affordable holiday ownership programs for middle and lower-middle-class families.
description: Club Travalet, launched by TVTRIPNSTAY HOLIDAYS PVT LTD, allows customers to pay in advance and enjoy vacations in installments without seasonal price fluctuations. Franchisees get operational guidance, marketing support, training, and inclusion of current IT systems.

name: Amber Destinations
short_description: Online travel franchise offering holiday bookings, tours, and related travel solutions targeting middle-class customers.
description: Amber Destinations provides online travel services including holiday packages, timeshare vacation ownership, and travel bookings via multi-unit franchise model supporting 20-50 franchises. Franchisees receive training, marketing support, IT system access, and operational guidance.

name: Southern Travels Pvt Ltd
short_description: Reputed travel company offering holiday/travel packages, corporate/leisure/international tours with franchise model, offices, fleet, hotels.
description: Southern Travels Pvt Ltd provides end-to-end travel services including corporate and leisure tours, coach/vehicle rentals, hotel bookings, and international/domestic tours. The company operates through a franchise model with multiple owned offices and fleet operations, offering training, operational support, IT systems, and marketing assistance.

name: Nexottel Hotel Resort
short_description: Mid-priced full-service business hotels and resorts across Pan Asia
description: Nexottel Hotel Resort is a premier hospitality brand offering mid-priced full-service business hotels and resorts across India and the GCC region. The brand focuses on operational excellence, consistent guest experience, strong sales and marketing support, hotel management, and technology-driven operations. Nexottel aims to scale to 100 hotels and 3,000 rooms across Pan Asia.

name: Trip Factory Pvt Ltd
short_description: AI-powered travel franchise offering customized holiday packages worldwide
description: Trip Factory is India's largest holiday store leveraging AI and machine learning to deliver customized global travel experiences. Operating across 49 countries, the platform handles over 100,000 daily transactions and is supported by a large global workforce. The franchise model enables entrepreneurs to run travel businesses with minimal investment using Trip Factory's proprietary technology, leads, and centralized support.

name: Sonix Car Decors
short_description: Premium automotive accessories and car decor franchise
description: Sonix Car Decors is a premium automotive accessories and car decor brand originating from Andhra Pradesh. Operating since 2010, the brand has evolved into a high-margin car studio-cum-distributorship model offering premium accessories, car electronics, detailing services, and tech upgrades. The franchise requires an investment of ?40-50 lakhs for a 750-1000 sq. ft. studio and provides full training, ERP-backed operations, and marketing support for pan-India expansion.
business_type: Private business / franchise-led car accessories chain

name: Frozen Bottle
short_description: Premium gelato and frozen dessert cafe franchise
description: Frozen Bottle is a premium frozen dessert and gelato cafe brand offering handcrafted ice creams, thick shakes, waffle jars, sundaes, and innovative jar-based desserts with a modern cafe experience.

name: Amul Ice Cream
short_description: One of India's largest and most trusted ice-cream brands offering 100% real milk products
description: Amul Ice Cream, a division of GCMMF, is one of India's largest and most trusted ice-cream brands, offering 100% real milk products through 2000+ outlets nationwide with a low-investment, zero-royalty franchise model.

name: Giani's Ice Cream
short_description: Heritage Indian ice-cream brand known for traditional flavors like Rabri Falooda, Kulfi, and Kesar Pista
description: Giani's Ice Cream is a heritage Indian ice-cream brand founded in 1956 in Delhi, known for its rich traditional flavors. From a small shop in Chandni Chowk, it has grown into a popular multi-city franchise offering ice creams, sundaes, shakes, and desserts. Recognized for quality, authentic taste, and strong customer loyalty.
leader_name: Giani Gurcharan Singh, Gurbachan Singh, Taranjeet Singh

name: Kumon India
short_description: Japanese after-school learning system for math and English enrichment
description: Kumon India is the Indian division of the global Kumon Institute of Education, a Japanese after-school learning system founded in 1958. The organization focuses on strengthening foundational skills in mathematics and English for children across age groups, from early learners to high-school students. With 200+ centers across India and over 60 years of global presence, Kumon uses standardized worksheets and self-learning methodology.
business_type: Coaching and Franchise - Math and Reading Enrichment

name: IBT Institute
short_description: Competitive exam coaching for Bank, SSC, Railways and Insurance exams
description: IBT Institute was founded in 2009 in Jalandhar, Punjab, initially for aspirants targeting one bank exam. Over time it has grown into a pan-India coaching brand with 100+ branches across the country. Its core aim is to provide quality coaching and preparation support for competitive government and bank-related exams including Bank PO, SSC, Railways, Insurance, MBA entrance exams, and Spoken English with comprehensive online mock-test platform.

name: Brain Checker
short_description: Psychometric assessments and career counselling franchise
description: Brain Checker is an education and career-guidance organization specializing in psychometric assessments, career counselling, aptitude testing, and student development programs. The company helps students understand their personality traits, learning styles, intelligence types, and career suitability using scientifically designed assessment tools and counselling frameworks.
business_type: Franchise and Branch-Based Counselling & Assessment Services

name: BlueStone Jewelry Private Limited
short_description: Premium fine jewelry brand operating on a FOCO franchise model.
description: BlueStone is India's leading fine jewelry brand founded in 2011, specializing in certified diamonds, gemstones, and premium jewelry. The brand operates on a Franchise-Owned Company-Operated (FOCO) model where franchisees invest in store infrastructure while the company manages operations, inventory, staff, and marketing. BlueStone is publicly listed and continues rapid expansion across high-street locations and premium malls in major Indian cities.

name: Medkart Pharmacy Private Limited
short_description: Affordable generic medicine pharmacy franchise focused on quality healthcare.
description: Medkart Pharmacy is India's trusted generic medicine pharmacy brand established in 2014. The company provides affordable healthcare solutions through a wide range of generic medicines, branded medicines, healthcare products, and wellness items. With 100+ stores across Gujarat and Rajasthan, Medkart combines physical retail pharmacies with an online presence to ensure accessibility and cost-effective healthcare for millions of customers.

name: Red Tape
short_description: International-style footwear and fashion retail brand
description: Red Tape is a well-known Indian fashion & lifestyle brand that primarily focuses on footwear, along with apparel and accessories. With a legacy spanning over two decades, Red Tape has built a strong reputation for offering international style, good quality, and comfort at competitive prices. The brand operates 400+ stores with a mix of company-owned and franchise outlets across India.

name: Paragon Footwear
short_description: India's trusted footwear brand offering men, women, and children shoes
description: Paragon Footwear is India's trusted footwear brand founded in 1974, offering a wide range of shoes for men, women, and children with a strong distribution network and commitment to quality. The brand operates through strategic retail locations in high-street shopping zones and premium malls. Franchise partnership model commenced in 2015 with focus on organized footwear retail expansion. Premium positioning with emphasis on high-visibility retail locations in tier-1 cities.
leader_name: P.V. Abraham, K.U. Thomas & K.U. Scaria

name: Just Dogs India
short_description: Premium pet retail and grooming franchise offering complete pet care solutions
description: Just Dogs India is India's largest pet retail and grooming chain specializing in pet grooming, retail, training services, and premium pet products. Established in 2011, the brand operates multiple formats ranging from boutique grooming spas to full-service concept stores. With presence across Tier-1 and Tier-2 cities, Just Dogs focuses on pet wellness, hygiene, safety, and customer satisfaction, making it a one-stop destination for pet care needs.

name: CIELHR
short_description: CIEL HR Franchise: A Future-Ready, Tech-Led Staffing Services Opportunity in India.
description: CIEL HR Franchise: A Future-Ready, Tech-Led Staffing Services Opportunity in India. If you are looking for a profitable staffing services franchise in India that combines brand reputation, technology, training, and nationwide business opportunities, CIEL HR stands out as one of the strongest choices.

name: Cult
short_description: Most gym investments fail for one simple reason: they rely too much on local branding, owner-led operations, and unpredictable demand.
description: Why Owning a Cult Gym Is a Business Decision, Not a Fitness Bet. Most gym investments fail for one simple reason: they rely too much on local branding, owner-led operations, and unpredictable demand.
